summary.title: Login System Threat Model
summary.description: This project models a web-based login system where users enter their username and password to access their accounts. The system includes a web application, server, and database that stores user credentials. The goal is to identify potential security threats and propose mitigation strategies.

diagrams.title: Login System DFD
diagrams.description: This diagram represents the data flow of a login system including user interaction, web application, server, and database.
